description: This Java source file defines the DigestUtils class, providing utility methods for computing message digests (hashes) using various algorithms. It includes methods for digesting byte arrays, ByteBuffers, Files, InputStreams, Paths, and Strings, as well as factory methods for obtaining MessageDigest instances for different algorithms. The class is designed to be immutable and thread-safe, facilitating common cryptographic hashing tasks within Java applications.
